column4: i am so tired of everything
it won't bring back my pet
i have been drinking too much
my mother never listens to me
my dad left when i was young
i had a strange dream last night
i keep having the same nightmare
the mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell
my cat knocked over my coffee
i think my roommate is stealing my food
my car broke down on the highway
i have a job interview tomorrow
my phone battery is always dying
i spilled wine on the carpet
i am addicted to my phone
i think my computer is haunted
what is the meaning of life
